## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass and linters are clean
- [ ] New or changed detection rule: corpus cases for the scam **and** at least two everyday messages that must stay `safe`
- [ ] No real phone numbers, UPI IDs, names, Aadhaar/PAN numbers or message text from real people in code, tests or docs (use made-up examples)
- [ ] Nothing the user checks is ever executed or opened (no running APKs, no fetching links from the device without consent)
- [ ] README / docs updated if a user would notice
